description: Sets Egeria up to receive the OpenLineage events Airflow publishes: catalogs the openlineage.events Kafka topic (filled by the shared-infra OpenLineage proxy) and makes it the OpenLineageKafkaListener connector's catalog target. Re-runs after a demo reset, which deletes that set-up. It runs the set-up once: when openlineage.events is already a catalog target of the OpenLineageKafkaListener it creates nothing, and when it cannot tell it refuses and creates nothing (each extra run used to add another catalog target).
